# Exercises {#sec-exercises .web-only}

{{< include _macros.qmd >}}

This page collects the exercises of all published chapters. The label of each exercise
links back to it in its chapter, where the surrounding text explains the notation and
the references. The exercises of each new chapter are added here when it is published.
The contents in the sidebar jump to each chapter, and the search of your browser (Ctrl-F, or Cmd-F on a Mac) finds an exercise by a word in its title or text.

::: {#exercise-list}
:::
